reason: The same approved source passed on a worker with over110GiB free after SDK cleanup but failed on a worker with71.61GiB total and only37.52GiB free afterward. SDK cleanup alone does not guarantee the fixed native build budget across the hosted pool.

actual_failure.phase: Prepare hosted runner disk, before compilation or native work

current_recovery.mode: One manually initiated normal failed-job retry on unchanged independently approved source.
current_recovery.observed: The unchanged60GiB guard passed and package compilation started. Production publication of this source remains pending.

eligibility: A genuine completed failure event matches the latest run id, attempt, exact source and supported workflow.
Release still builds protected Main, or same-repository PR head and tested/current Main base remain unchanged.
The disk-preparation source is byte-identical to reviewed Main.
Exactly one known compiler/native job failed only Prepare hosted runner disk; actual build/test execution has not started.
A single bounded report from that exact run and attempt proves a GitHub-hosted Linux worker below the unchanged60GiB minimum.
Native retries require an available successful immutable package-stage handoff.
automation.excluded: Code, test, security/scanner, SDK cleanup errors, forks, stale source/base/attempt, missing/truncated evidence and exhausted budgets are not retried.
automation.safety: Controllers execute only their exact reviewed Main checkout. PR reports are parsed as bounded JSON/ZIP data; only numeric measurements and hashes enter public intent, never arbitrary report strings or environment data.
automation.permissions: Planning is read-only. A separate executor has Actions write, Contents read and Pull requests read. It cannot write source or approve PRs. Signing/publication permissions remain on separate archive jobs.
automation.traceability: Exact eligible intent is attested and archived immutably before any retry. Execution verifies the offline bundle and exact intent hash, rechecks current source/evidence/budget, requests one job plus dependants, and archives the actual result. Ambiguous POST transport errors are never repeated.
automation.review_notifications: For PR retries, the normal trusted admission workflow is refreshed after the actual new attempt is observed. Full CI and independent review remain required; review requests wait for successful qualification.
automation.retention: Tiny temporary plan/result handoffs expire after one day and enter the two-hour cleanup for completed known workflows. Only actual capacity decisions create durable archives.

validation.actual_historical_replay: The real failed attempt qualifies. The already-retried live event is rejected. This read-only verification made no GitHub mutation.
cases: Exact immutable intent and hosted signer required

approval: This is new workflow/controller authority. It needs its own actual independent human review on the final qualified head; PR48 approval does not approve it.
